dialogue.content: アイノエールさん、こんばんは。本日は宜しくお願い致します。ご準備できましたらお知らせください。
dialogue.English: Good evening, Ms. Ainoel. Thank you for meeting with me today. Please let me know when you are ready.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。よろしくお願いいたします。いつでも大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you. I’m ready whenever you are.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。それではロールプレイを開始させて頂きます。宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you. We’ll now begin the role-play. I appreciate your cooperation.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: 今日はご相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.content: まず初めにあなたの年齢、性別、ご相談の中で何とお呼びしたらよいか教えてください。
dialogue.English: To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like me to call you during our session?

dialogue.content: ４０歳、女、ゆり　でお願いします
dialogue.English: I’m 40, female, and please call me Yuri.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ゆりさん、今日のご相談はどの様な事でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Yuri, what would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: ママ友との関係で悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I’m struggling with my relationship with a mom friend.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。それは苦しいですよね。具体的にどんなお悩みかお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be difficult. Could you tell me more specifically what’s troubling you?

dialogue.content: 母子家庭のママ友が一方的に誘ってきて、
dialogue.English: A mom friend who's a single mother keeps inviting me out, but it's always one-sided,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 例えば海に行こうと。主人に相談して駄目だったらごめんねと、伝えていたのに
dialogue.English: For example, she suggested we go to the beach. I told her I would have to ask my husband and that I was sorry if we couldn't make it, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: ほんとにごめんね、と埋め合わせも考えてお断りしたら
dialogue.English: When I told her we couldn't go, saying I was truly sorry and that I'd try to make it up to her,

dialogue.content: この子がひどく傷ついた。どうしてくれるの？と・・・
dialogue.English: she said, "My child is deeply hurt. What are you going to do about it?"...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 怖くなって距離を置くようにするんですが
dialogue.English: It scared me, so I've been trying to keep my distance, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: またしても、子供同士で約束つけてきたりと・・
dialogue.English: but then she has the kids make plans together...

dialogue.content: 繰り返しにしんどくなって
dialogue.English: It's a repeating cycle, and it's become exhausting.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 困ってます
dialogue.English: I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それは怖くて不安な経験でしたよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been a frightening and unsettling experience for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのママ友とはいつからのお付き合いですか？
dialogue.English: How long have you known this mom friend?

dialogue.content: もう五年くらい。初めは話するくらいから始まりました
dialogue.English: For about five years now. It started with just casual conversation.

dialogue.content: なるほど、5年前からの関係なんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you’ve known each other for about five years.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみにお子さんは今おいくつですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, how old is your child now?

dialogue.content: 小学５年生です
dialogue.English: They're in the fifth grade.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you.

dialogue.content: そのママ友はお誘いを断ると責めてこられるようですが、ゆりさんはその時どう感じましたか？
dialogue.English: It sounds like this mom friend blames you when you decline her invitations. Yuri, how did you feel at that time?

dialogue.content: 約束した時に、ダメかもしれないよと伝えたのに、自分の子が傷ついたって、怖い人だなと思いました
dialogue.English: Even though I told her when we made the plan that it might not work out, she insisted her child was hurt. I thought she was a scary person.

dialogue.content: ええ、最初にちゃんと断る可能性も説明したのにいきなり責められると、それは怖くなりますよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, to be blamed so suddenly, even after you explained the possibility of having to cancel, must have been very frightening.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 確かに、
dialogue.English: Indeed,

dialogue.content: ゆりさんはそうして責められた時、相手のママ友にはどんな風に対応されたのですか？
dialogue.English: When you were blamed like that, how did you respond to her?

dialogue.content: 例えばひたすら謝るとか、とりあえず誤って避けるとか。そんな怖い中でどう頑張って対応されたのか、よかったら教えてください。
dialogue.English: For example, did you just keep apologizing, or apologize and then avoid her? If you don't mind sharing, please tell me how you managed to handle such a scary situation.

dialogue.content: 主人がダメだって言ってるとは言えず、ちょっとその日は無理そうで、また機会があったら行きたいよねって言いました。
dialogue.English: I couldn't bring myself to say my husband said no, so I just said it seemed difficult that day and that I'd love to go if there was another chance.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それは色々と悩まれて考えて返答されたんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You must have thought long and hard about how to respond.

dialogue.content: 以降、海は誘われなくなったし、他にもそんな被害に遭った人もいると知りました
dialogue.English: After that, she stopped inviting me to the beach, and I learned that other people have had similar experiences with her.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、ゆりさんの他にも同じ経験をされている方がいるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so there are others besides you who have had the same experience.

dialogue.content: はい、母子家庭なので気を使いました
dialogue.English: Yes, I was trying to be considerate because she's a single mother.

dialogue.content: というか、
dialogue.English: Or rather…

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 母子家庭を振りかざす言い方をされるので、主人がとか、お父さんがという言い方は避けて付き合ってました
dialogue.English: she uses her single-mother status as a sort of weapon, so I've avoided mentioning my husband or "his father" when I'm with her.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうだったんですね・・・以前からその方は母子家庭のことをよく口にされていたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it was... She had often brought up being a single parent even before this incident.

dialogue.content: それは、受け取りても気を使いますよね。
dialogue.English: That would certainly make anyone feel like they have to be careful what they say.

dialogue.content: 5年前からの関係とお聞きしましたが、お子さん同士は仲がよいのですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you've known her for five years; are your children close?

dialogue.content: 子供同士もあちらからの一方的な所があります。度が過ぎる事多いです
dialogue.English: Their relationship is also one-sided, initiated by her child. It often goes too far.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・それは悩ましいですね・・ということは、ゆりさんのお子さんも相手のお子さんに対して少し困られているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... that's concerning. Does this mean your child is also having some trouble with the other child?

dialogue.content: 仲良しというよりは、勝手に家に来られるので仕方なしとか・・
dialogue.English: It’s less that they’re close friends, and more that their child just comes over uninvited, so we feel like we have no choice but to go along with it…

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: はい、押しが強くて、甘えてこられるのが良くわかります
dialogue.English: Yes, their pushiness and the way they lean on others is very apparent.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それはゆりさんのおこさんもお困りかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so your child might be struggling with this as well.

dialogue.content: はい、一度ひどい事もありました
dialogue.English: Yes, something terrible happened once.

dialogue.content: どんなことですか？おしえてください。
dialogue.English: What happened? If you're comfortable, please tell me.

dialogue.content: プールで背中に乗って沈めようと、その子は遊び半分なんですが、それがしつこくて、うちの子は完全に沈められてる状態だったと他のママから聞きました。気を付けてねって助言をもらった事が
dialogue.English: At the pool, their child got on my child's back and tried to push them under the water. I think they were just playing, but they were so persistent that another mom told me my child was completely submerged at one point. She advised me to be careful.

dialogue.content: そんなことがあったのですね・・・それはお子さんも苦しかったですよね。ゆりさんも心配で不安で辛かったですよね。
dialogue.English: That happened... Your child must have had a very difficult time. And you must have been worried, anxious, and distressed as well.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そんな嫌な経験をお話しくださりありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing such a difficult experience.

dialogue.content: いえ、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: No, it's okay.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。ゆりさんもお子さんもその親子にかなりお困りのように感じましたが、これからどうしていきたいと考えておられますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. It sounds like both you and your child are quite troubled by this mother and her child. How would you like to move forward from here?

dialogue.content: たとえば、もう離れたいとか、何とかうまく付き合いたいとかありますか？
dialogue.English: For instance, do you want to distance yourselves completely, or do you want to find a way to get along with them somehow?

dialogue.content: そうですね、小さなことは他にもあるけど、上手く付き合いたいですね
dialogue.English: Well, there are other small issues, but I’d like to find a way to manage the relationship.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。そうなんですね。ゆりさんがどうしたいかで、かんがえていく方向が変わるのでまずお聞きしました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. I see. I asked that first because the direction we take will depend on what you want to do.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 小さなことは色々とありますが、きっと今までにいろんなことで悩まれてきたのですよね。
dialogue.English: You mentioned there are many small things; I imagine you’ve wrestled with a lot up to now.

dialogue.content: はい、微妙だなって所の困りごとはありました
dialogue.English: Yes, there have been some tricky and troublesome situations.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それでもお子さんもゆりさんもそのママ友親子とは、なんとか頑張って我慢しながらも関係を続けてこられたんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. And yet, both you and your child have managed to continue the relationship with them, enduring it and trying your best.

dialogue.content: はい、そんな感じですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s about right.

dialogue.content: ええ、断ることもできたかもしれない中、ご自宅にも迎え入れて、とても我慢されてきたと感じました。
dialogue.English: Yes, even though you could have refused, you still welcomed them into your home. I can see how much you’ve had to endure.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 母子家庭についてもママ友の方が口にされることもあり、傷つけないようにと配慮されて、我慢しながらも相手への気遣いを感じ、とても優しいですよね。
dialogue.English: You've also been considerate about her being a single mother, trying not to hurt her feelings even while enduring so much yourself. I can sense your concern for her; you are very kind.

dialogue.content: その親が他で何を言うか分からないって所もありましたので
dialogue.English: I was also worried about what she might say about me to other people.

dialogue.content: ええ、その不安もあったんですね。確かに自分のいないところで何か言われるのは嫌ですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, so you had that worry as well. It's certainly unpleasant to have things said about you behind your back.

dialogue.content: はい。母子家庭と言いながら、甘やかしてるって思う所もあったので、どんな誤解をされるのか分からないと思いました
dialogue.English: Yes. Even though she talks about being a single mother, I felt she was spoiling her child, so I was worried about what kind of misunderstandings might arise.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・勝手に誤解されて、あることないこと言われるのは嫌だし不安ですよね。
dialogue.English: I see... It's unpleasant and worrying to be misunderstood and have rumors spread about you.

dialogue.content: 子供がまたその子に何かされるのも警戒してます
dialogue.English: I'm also wary that her child might do something to my child again.

dialogue.content: そうですね、そこは心配なところですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s a very understandable concern.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その距離感が難しいです
dialogue.English: It's hard to find the right distance.

dialogue.content: うん、ママ友との距離感は子どもが間にいるので難しいと感じますよね。特に色々と疑問がある方とならなおさらですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, maintaining distance with a mom friend can be difficult when your children are involved. Especially with someone you have so many reservations about.

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s exactly right.

dialogue.content: ええ、その悩ましい気持ちよく伝わってきます。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can really sense how troubling this is for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。親だけの問題なら、さようなら、なんですがね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. If it were just an issue between the parents, I could just say goodbye, but...

dialogue.content: ええ、とてもよく分かります。でも子どもが関係すると、そこも考えなくてはならないですよね。どうしたら一番ストレスの少ない関係を保てるのか、一緒に考えたいのですが、
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand that very well. But when children are involved, you have to consider that, too. I'd like for us to think together about how to maintain this relationship with the least amount of stress.

dialogue.content: お子さん同士の関係もありますよね。
dialogue.English: There’s also the relationship between the children to consider.

dialogue.content: はい。その子に好かれてるので。うちの子にも友達選べとも言えず・・
dialogue.English: Yes. Her child is fond of mine, so I can't exactly tell my child to choose their friends...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、好かれているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see—so their child is fond of yours.

dialogue.content: ゆりさんやお子さんがお相手の方の甘えを半ば押されてでも受け止めておられますものね。
dialogue.English: After all, you and your child have been accommodating their neediness, even when it’s been forced upon you.

dialogue.content: はい。どうやら。親が絡んで約束はしないようにしました。距離を保とうと。そしたら子供だけで家に来るようになり、
dialogue.English: Yes, apparently so. I tried to keep my distance by no longer making plans that involved the parents. But then, the child started coming over to our house on their own,

dialogue.content: かぶってしまいすみません。
dialogue.English: I’m sorry for speaking over you.

dialogue.content: うんうん、
dialogue.English: Mm-hm,

dialogue.content: いえ、子供同士で約束してないのに、結構遠方の中その子供が勝手に家に来たとか・・
dialogue.English: No, it's fine. It's that even when the children hadn't made any plans, their child would come over to our house uninvited from quite a distance away...

dialogue.content: なるほど・・
dialogue.English: I see…

dialogue.content: 事故があったら怖いからと言わせてもらいましたが、
dialogue.English: I told her that I was worried an accident could happen, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫なんって
dialogue.English: she just said, "It's fine."

dialogue.content: 今はこのまま距離をたもとうと思います
dialogue.English: For now, I think I'll just try to keep my distance as it is.

dialogue.content: それは困ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: That must be very troubling for you.

dialogue.content: 片道４０分もかけて
dialogue.English: It's a 40-minute trip one way.

dialogue.content: 来て、帰りは祖父に送ってもらえないかなんって言われて
dialogue.English: The child came all that way and then asked if my father (their grandfather) could give them a ride home.

dialogue.content: ええ、それは小学生には遠い・・・
dialogue.English: Yes, that's a long way for an elementary school student...

dialogue.content: ビックリ仰天でした
dialogue.English: I was absolutely floored.

dialogue.content: そうですね。なかなか考えてしまう点がたくさんありますね。。
dialogue.English: I agree. There are certainly many concerning things to think about here.

dialogue.content: すみません、愚痴のような話をしてしまいました
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I feel like I've just been venting.

dialogue.content: いえいえ、お聞かせいただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Not at all, thank you for sharing this with me.

dialogue.content: 少しスッキリしました
dialogue.English: I feel a little better now.

dialogue.content: よかったです。それだけ我慢しながらも、おこさんのことを考えて、ゆりさんが何とか対応されてきた証拠だと思います。
dialogue.English: I'm glad. I think it's proof of how much you've been trying to manage all of this, all while being patient and thinking of your child.

dialogue.content: ゆりさんの今のママ友この距離は、お子さんのことを考えるとすぐに何とかできることではないかもしれませんが、
dialogue.English: Considering your child, this situation with your mom friend might not be something that can be resolved immediately, but...

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 時には距離も必要かと思うので、そういう時はこのご時世なので、「体調が・・」など、少し必要な嘘も交えながら、ゆっくりいい関係まで距離を取っていく方法を考えていきたいです。
dialogue.English: I think some distance is necessary at times. In those moments, especially given the current climate, I'd like for us to think about ways to gradually create a healthier distance, perhaps by using small "white lies" like, "I'm not feeling well..." when needed.

dialogue.content: はい、必要な嘘、で上手く関係を保ちたいと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I'd like to use those "necessary white lies" to manage the relationship well.

dialogue.content: お子さんのために我慢もため込むと心が辛くなってくるので、私たちはいつでも待っておりますので、ここで吐き出しながら、必要なことを考えていけると嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: Bottling things up for your child’s sake takes a toll on your heart. We’re always here for you, so I hope you'll feel you can vent here as we think together about what needs to be done.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: そうですね、お子さんも大切な存在ですが、なによりゆりさんの心も大切な存在ですものね！！
dialogue.English: That's right. Your child is precious, of course, but above all, your own heart and well-being are just as important!

dialogue.content: こちらこそ今日はありがとうございました。少しでも心のうちをお話ししてくださっていたらよかったです。
dialogue.English: No, thank you for today. I'm glad if you were able to share even a little of what's on your mind.

dialogue.content: そろそろ終了のお時間になりますが、本日はこれでご相談を終了させて頂いてよろしいででしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's almost time to wrap up. Is it alright if we conclude our session for today?

dialogue.content: はい、終了でお願いします。今日は聴いて下さりありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, please conclude the session. Thank you for listening to me today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそお悩みをお聞かせいただきありがとうございました。ゆりさんとお子さんのこれからを応援しております。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well for sharing your concerns with me. I'll be rooting for you and your child.

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談下さりありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your consultation today.

dialogue.content: これでロールプレイを終了させて頂いてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it alright if we conclude the role-play now?

dialogue.content: はい、終了でお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please conclude it.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。ロールプレイを終了致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you. This concludes the role-play.
